0x0008C7.en: 「As I am now...@　this is my limit...!」

0x0009C0.en: 「Damn it!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x000A3A.en: 「Is this... as far as I go...?」

0x000B21.en: 「Oh dear...@　how uncool of me, geez!」

0x000BEA.en: 「Ngh! So this is how it ends...!」

0x000C25.en: 「No way I'm losing here...!@　This isn't fun...」

0x000C79.en: 「I blew it...!@　No choice but to bail...」

0x000DCA.en: 「This is as far as I go... the rest is yours.」

0x000E76.en: 「No good, took too many hits... I'm retreating!」

0x000EC3.en: 「Well, I'm beaten. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000F01.en: 「Kyaah, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x000F48.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x000FF3.en: 「Ngh... so I'll be the falling star... I'm ejecting!」

0x001072.en: 「Th-this is as far as I can go...!」

0x0010AA.en: 「Owowow... I give. My math was off.」

0x00119C.en: 「Tch! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x0011E3.en: 「I'm sorry. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x001218.en: 「Damn it! Is this all the strength I've got...!?」

0x001304.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@ I've still got so much to learn...!」

0x001352.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x00140D.en: 「Sorry, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x00143C.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x00147A.en: 「Well, well. So this is where it ends.」

0x0014A9.en: 「I can't go on any further. I'll take my leave now.」

0x001534.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll pull back for now...!」

0x0018C7.en: 「So I still have much to learn...!」

0x001A3A.en: 「Hey, Mio... that outfit of yours,@ did you maybe put it together yourself?」

0x001AC4.en: 「Of course.@ The way you paired the corset belt with the boots...@ and that badge on your shoulder, it's fresh if you look at it right.」

0x001B73.en: 「...How is it women can get so worked up talking about clothes?」

0x001BD5.en: 「Well, plenty of guys love fashion too.」

0x001C12.en: 「And there are women who are hopeless mecha nuts.@ One of them even designs Magic Armor.」

0x001CA7.en: 「Yeah. You two would probably hit it off.@ I'll introduce you if we get the chance.」

0x001D7B.en: 「Here, take this.@ The corrected range-of-motion data for the Wing Binder.@ Well, see you.」

0x001E0F.en: 「Thought I'd go check on Ing.@ Later.」

0x001E6F.en: 「You sure you don't want to go after her?」

0x001E9A.en: 「Yeah...@ At times like this, it's better to give her some space.@ About 80 percent of the time, anyway.」

0x001F4C.en: 「By the way, the Wing Binder,@ is that the thing on the R-Blade knockoff@ over in that hangar?」

0x001FE2.en: 「It's not a knockoff.@ It's Unit 3, the one Ryusei was testing before.」

0x002044.en: 「They fitted it with binders housing beam cannons,@ jacket armor, and a Tesla Drive,@ to boost its overall performance across the board.」

0x002109.en: 「Huh, has it ever actually sortied before?」

0x0021B2.en: 「What's wrong? You're in such a rush...」

0x0021E6.en: 「A transmission came in from Tytti, nya!」

0x002243.en: 「That's right, nya, get up to the bridge, quick!」

0x0022CD.en: 「The pilot of Gaddess, a Machine God@ just like Cybuster!」

0x002384.en: 「Tytti! It's me, Masaki!@ Can you hear me!?」

0x0023D1.en: 「Masaki, where have you been all this time!?@ Honestly, worrying us sick! Your big sis is angry!」

0x002457.en: 「Gah! I told you to quit talking like that!@ I'm back now, so what's the problem!?」

0x0024E0.en: 「No, that won't do.@ To begin with, you...」

0x002533.en: 「Yoo-hoo, big brother! You been doing okay?」

0x0025B0.en: 「Heh-heh, I tagged along with big sis Tytti.§@ Staying home to watch the place is so boring.」

0x00265A.en: 「Masaki, Coral Canyon is close to you too.@ I'll send the coordinates, let's rendezvous there.」

0x00270F.en: 「Such a gorgeous big sister, and a super-cute little sister...@ M-man, I'm jealous.」

0x00276B.en: 「Neither of them is blood-related to me.」

0x0027CA.en: 「...Captain, I'd like to rendezvous with those two@ at Coral Canyon. Can we set course for there?」

0x002856.en: 「I don't mind, but what's the chance of running into the Shutedonias army?」

0x0028A2.en: 「I'd say high.@ The terrain there is well suited to an ambush.」

0x0028FE.en: 「True...@ It's a good spot for a quiet meetup,@ but that goes for the enemy too.」

0x002985.en: 「Then I'll issue a level-one combat readiness order.@ We'll stay on strict air-and-ground alert and head for the rendezvous point.」

0x002A02.en: 「The coordinates Lady Tytti gave us are around here.」

0x002A4B.en: 「Looks like those two aren't here yet...」

0x002A88.en: 「Unknown approaching, straight in from two o'clock!」

0x002AC8.en: 「An ambush after all!@ Forward secondary guns, VLSM, prepare to fire!」

0x002B8A.en: 「Hmhm, so that's the Steel Dragon Squadron's Hagane.@ Send out those three.」

0x002C2D.en: 「Wh-why are they with the Shutedonias army!?」

0x002C6A.en: 「Maybe they don't know what's going on,@ and Shutedonias talked them into it,@ and now they're fighting...!」

0x002D00.en: 「With us right in front of them? That doesn't add up.」

0x002D62.en: 「There's probably some reason behind it.@ Like hostages being held.」

0x002DBE.en: 「That's a real possibility.@ The R-1 and ART-1 are nowhere to be seen.」

0x002E1D.en: 「Azuki, try to open a channel to them.」

0x002EB1.en: 「Captain, the SRX Team@ isn't answering our hails!」

0x002F0D.en: 「...Which means something's stopping them from responding.@ Irm's read might be right on the money.」

0x002F96.en: 「You all understand, don't you?@ Try to communicate or make any suspicious move,@ and the hostages are dead.」

0x003042.en: (I'm counting on you, Aya... it's all riding on you.)

0x0030D8.en: 「Hey, isn't there some way to reach them besides radio?@ Light signals, or flag semaphore?」

0x003143.en: 「If we could, we'd already be doing it.」

0x003177.en: 「Hmm...@ Then short of telepathy, I guess it's hopeless.」

0x003221.en: 「There's a way to reach them without tipping off the enemy!@ Lieutenant Aya can do it!」

0x0032BF.en: 「Steel 2!@ Activate Lieutenant Aya's T-LINK moderator@ right away!」

0x003340.en: 「We might be able to pick up some kind of message@ from the pattern of her telekinesis alpha pulses!」

0x0033D5.en: 「Understood. All of you, buy us some time.@　But don't shoot down the SRX Team's machines.」

0x00344F.en: 「And don't touch the enemy mothership either, just in case.@ The hostages may be held aboard it.」

0x003521.en: 「Captain, Ensign Ryoto was right!@　We've detected a signal in the strong/weak@　telekinesis-alpha pulses from the T-LINK Moderator!」

0x00362D.en: 「Mai's being held aboard the enemy mothership...!@　Relay this to all units at once!」

0x00368F.en: 「Captain, shouldn't we tell Captain Viletta@　and the others what we've realized?」

0x00373D.en: 「I get the situation, but@　how are we supposed to rescue Mai?」

0x003796.en: 「Get too close to the mothership and she'll be a shield.@　If we can draw their attention and slip aboard...」

0x00382E.en: 「Allow me. Back when I served@　in the Shutedonias army,@　I crewed a Sodium-class vessel.」

0x0038C4.en: 「Even if you sneak aboard,@ an old geezer built like you'd be spotted in no time.」

0x003938.en: 「We could ride in on the Highfamilia@　and sneak in, nya.」

0x003994.en: 「You'd be hard to spot, sure, but if trouble hits...@　no, wait. Those two...@　they just might work...」

0x003A49.en: 「Yeah. For now, just buy us some time.」

0x003B7C.en: 「...Masaki filled me in.@　Leave the hostage rescue to me.」

0x003BFD.en: 「Yes, I'll find a way.@　Sorry, but please keep the enemy distracted.」

0x003C8D.en: 「Forward main guns, one and two! Ready to fire!@　Target the mothership's perimeter! Don't hit the hull!」

0x003D1D.en: 「What are those three doing!@　If we don't sink the Hagane fast, the hostage...」

0x003D85.en: 「No, there's a better use for her.@　Bring the hostage here.」

0x003E96.en: 「F-from the rear!@　The aft mecha bay door's been breached!」

0x003F0B.en: 「Someone appears to have slipped aboard through the breach!」

0x003F51.en: 「Don't tell me they're after the hostage...!?@　How in the world did they learn@　what was going on over here...!?」

0x003FE1.en: 「No, more importantly!@　Get that girl back to her cell, now!」

0x00405F.en: 「Ngh! What are those things! My shots won't land!!」

0x004178.en: 「...Found you sooner than expected.@　You are Lady Mai Kobayashi?」

0x0041F6.en: 「I am Freki. That is Geri.@　We are familiars.」

0x004286.en: 「Our master is the pilot of the Mazan-God Gaddess.@　We've come to rescue you.」

0x004341.en: 「No, I want to reach the hangar on the far side.@　My unit's there... it's important.」

0x0043EC.en: 「Well done, Freki, Geri.@　The hostage girl? Did you get her clear of the fortress?」

0x004457.en: 「We guided her to her unit.@　She should be launching shortly.」

0x0044E7.en: 「Yes, the Mazan-God bound to the water spirit Gad.」

0x004546.en: 「An enemy unit in the hangar@　is trying to launch!」

0x004624.en: 「Yeah. As you can see, I got Ryu's R-1 back too.」

0x0046D2.en: 「Freki and Geri aren't dogs -@　they're wolf familiars.」

0x004744.en: 「Anyway, I'm just glad it worked out.」

0x00477B.en: 「Yeah, you saved us, Tytti.@　And Freki and Geri too.」

0x004808.en: 「Not at all... now we can fight back without holding back.」

0x004848.en: 「Right.@　Aya, Rai, Mai - let's give them a proper thank-you.」

0x0048B7.en: 「Riciel Grenor... don't think you'll get off easy.」

0x004900.en: 「Fine then, I'll crush you all together.@　Launch every remaining unit!」

0x004981.en: 「Heh, you think a stunt like that'll stop us!」

0x004A07.en: 「Enemy contacts in the combat zone have vanished.」

0x004A38.en: 「Good... maintain strict air and ground alert.@　Bring the SRX team aboard in sequence.」

0x004AA0.en: 「Gotta not hit them...@　and not get hit either!」

0x004B2D.en: 「Well now, this'll test our acting skills.」

0x004B8C.en: 「Turning us against each other...!@　The Shutedonias army fights dirty!」

0x004C37.en: 「I-I know!@　But this is harder than I thought!」

0x004C8D.en: 「Th-they're coming at us for real, aren't they...!?」

0x004CCA.en: 「Knock that eyesore of a Mazan-God out of the sky!」

0x004D04.en: 「You really think you can go toe-to-toe@　with my Cybuster and win!」

0x004D69.en: 「Taking that hostage is going to cost you!」

0x004DA3.en: 「Thanks to your meddling,@　the whole operation's ruined!」

0x004E3F.en: 「Hmph, I'll turn the tables on you!」

0x004E73.en: 「How did the enemy find out about the hostage...!?」

0x004EB9.en: 「There are methods you couldn't even imagine!」

0x004EFC.en: 「I'll give you credit for your acting,@　at least!」

0x004F49.en: 「Now that Mai's back, no more mercy!」

0x004F86.en: Holy Langran Kingdom - Framos Province - Coral Canyon

0x004FE5.en: 「...Aya, Rai and I warped to the same spot,@　but only Mai came out a little ways off.」

0x00506B.en: 「By the time we found her,@　she'd already been captured by the Shutedonias army...@　We had no choice but to meet their demands.」

0x00512F.en: 「But I'm so glad you picked up on our message.@　It was a real gamble...」

0x0051C7.en: 「The one who noticed it was Ryoto.」

0x005207.en: 「No, Mio's the one who gave me the idea...」

0x005250.en: 「But powering up the T-LINK Moderator@　was your idea, Ryoto. Impressive.」

0x0052CD.en: （Huh, and he was in a foul mood before the fight.）

0x005307.en: 「...By the way, so Mai's the one piloting the R-1, nya.」

0x005350.en: 「That's 'cause Ryusei went missing@ in the ART-1, right?」

0x0053E9.en: 「Told Excellen the same thing -@ I was traveling together with@ Ryusei and Kyosuke.」

0x00547A.en: 「Ryusei probably made it back to the surface,@ or he might be here in La Gias.」

0x00552B.en: 「Well, one thing's certain - he's back on our side.」

0x005571.en: 「Then maybe I'll get to see him soon...」

0x0055EB.en: 「Kyosuke too - if they're both here,@　we need to find them fast.」

0x005659.en: 「We might learn something about the surface folk@　once we link up with Prince Feil.」

0x0056C7.en: 「...Oops, my bad.@　I never properly introduced Tytti and Presia.」

0x00573B.en: 「Tytti's from the surface... pilot of the Mazan-God Gaddess.」

0x00578A.en: 「I'm Tytti Norbuck.@　Pleased to meet you all.」

0x0057E3.en: 「Likewise.@　I'm Lieutenant Irmgard Kazahara.@　If there's anything you need aboard, just ask.」

0x00589E.en: 「And this here's my little sister, Presia.」

0x0058D2.en: 「I'm Presia Zan Zenosakis.@　My big brother's always in your care,@　everyone in the Steel Dragon Squadron.」

0x005993.en: 「But she's not Japanese, is she. Could it be...」

0x0059D6.en: 「After I came to Langran,@ Presia's father adopted me.@ So she's my sister by adoption, so to speak.」

0x005A9A.en: 「If there's anything you don't know, feel free to ask me too.」

0x005AF9.en: 「...That's our Lieutenant Irm. Wide range of coverage.」

0x005B55.en: 「...Excellen, don't go saying stuff like that.」

0x005B9B.en: 「Tytti, we're heading to the royal capital now@　to rescue Princess Monica.」

0x005C0F.en: 「I see... that might be a good move.@　The capital's defenses are thin right now.」

0x005C84.en: 「Yes, Prince Feil's engaging the Shutedonias army@　on the Nakut Plains.」

0x005CEF.en: 「The prince is? That works in our favor.@　Then we can push straight into the capital@　through the lightly guarded Mount Ginas to the west.」

0x005D79.en: 「I'm coming with you.@　Let's join forces and rescue the princess.」
